name: beatgrove-building-studio
description: Create painted isometric artist and biome buildings with BeatGrove visual references and lightweight transparent runtime exports.

interface.longDescription: Generate artist-inspired and biome-specific buildings in BeatGrove's detailed painted isometric style. Includes visual references, contributor prompts, transparent PNG/WebP export scripts and technical integration guidance. Uses the host's image and file-processing capabilities; no server or repository access is required for contributor artwork.
defaultPrompt: Create a compact painted isometric music lodge representing my chosen artist, then export a lightweight transparent PNG and WebP.
Create a small decaying house for a BeatGrove biome using the bundled art references.
Check my building's transparency, miniature legibility and runtime file size.
